game_theory_patterns.definition: Signals fail to credibly transmit private information or intentions.

game_theory_patterns.name: Bayesian Game / Incomplete Information
game_theory_patterns.definition: Agents choose strategies under uncertainty about types, preferences, or payoffs of others.

game_theory_patterns.name: Coalition Formation Instability
game_theory_patterns.definition: Coalitions form, split, or block action due to unstable distribution of gains and veto power.

game_theory_patterns.name: Auction / Bidding Failure
game_theory_patterns.definition: Procurement or allocation mechanism induces strategic bidding, winner’s curse, collusion, or inefficient allocation.

game_theory_patterns.name: Matching Market Failure
game_theory_patterns.definition: Agents and positions/resources are mismatched because of preference revelation, constraints, or allocation rule defects.

game_theory_patterns.name: Evolutionary Strategy Lock-In
game_theory_patterns.definition: A strategy persists because it is locally stable, even when globally inferior alternatives exist.

agent_error_model.system_error: nonlinear aggregation of agent error profiles through mechanisms and interactions

alpha_matrix_spec.description: Alpha matrix stores directed influence between error modes: alpha[p][q] means activation of p increases or decreases q.

initial_edges.evidence_basis: Present/hyperbolic discounting can make deferral more likely.
Treating available information as sufficient can omit externalities.
Dissent-cost asymmetry can produce visible consensus without true consensus.
Delay-as-veto can contribute to deadlock equilibrium.
Mandate-boundary exploitation can generate jurisdictional/externality-scope mismatch.
Temporal degradation can normalize status quo dependence.

inference_rules.description: Persistent non-optimality is inferred when cognitive/informational, incentive, and mechanism signals co-occur across time.
A detected game-theoretic structure increases priors for linked Errorlogy modes.
System error must not be reduced to a linear sum when L5 mechanisms are active.
Mode detection should use membership/confidence scores, not yes/no labels.

methods_layer.principle: Ontology describes what can go wrong; methods_layer describes how the system detects, estimates, learns, validates and simulates those failures.

DET.name: Detection / evidence extraction
DET.purpose: Convert text, documents, datasets, decisions and event traces into evidence-linked μ estimates for CB/SF/MP/GT/HM.

methods.name: Weak supervision
best_for: scaling annotation without full manual labeling

PM.name: Pattern mining
PM.purpose: Find recurring combinations, chains and clusters of failure modes across cases.

CA.name: Causal / structural inference
CA.purpose: Estimate directed relationships between modes and distinguish correlation from candidate causality.

methods.name: Counterfactual analysis
methods.example: What if SF-002 had not occurred?

GA.name: Graph analytics
GA.purpose: Analyze centrality, diffusion, communities and bottlenecks in error, actor and institution graphs.

SIM.name: Simulation / regime inference
SIM.purpose: Use μ vectors, α edges, GT/HM/MP mappings and mechanisms to infer system regimes and forecast dynamics.

VAL.name: Validation / calibration
VAL.purpose: Prevent overfitting, post-hoc storytelling and false certainty.

anti_overclaim_rules: Do not infer intent from outcome alone.
Separate correlation, predictive causality and normative blame.
Always preserve evidence links for each detected mode.
Use fuzzy membership μ, not binary certainty, unless the record explicitly supports binary classification.
Treat PNO as a system regime, not as proof of individual guilt.

generative_topology_layer.name: Generative Topological Layer
generative_topology_layer.purpose: Synthesize new failure modes, parameters and criteria from topology of error space

concepts.error_space: manifold / fuzzy topological space of all failure modes
concepts.topological_gap: region with high case density but low mode coverage
concepts.candidate_mode: new failure mode inferred from gap

operations.name: Gap detection
operations.description: Find low-density regions in taxonomy but high-density in case embeddings

operations.name: Function synthesis
operations.description: Construct new f_new that explains unexplained cases

operations.name: Topology deformation
operations.description: Update embedding space with new modes

operations.name: Persistence check
operations.description: Validate stability of candidate mode across cases
